title: Review fixes, Major: delivery day, Scout and Undo, online dead ends (REP-122)
problem: REP-122 found nine Major problems; the owner chose to fix eight (S1 goes with Closing Day in PLAN-108).
scope: S2: on a standing order's due day the order's pieces count as wanted, Auto load loads them, and the row says who they are for
S3: Undo takes back purchases only; a favour card once played stays played (owner's option)
ON-01: quick matches keep upgrades (owner's option): RULES.md and the room's code comment say so; the game does not change
ON-02: Create a room forgets a used invite
ON-03: an unknown or expired room code says so, with a way back
ON-04: a rematch counts only the people still there and says who left
ON-05: a disconnected lobby seat is freed after the usual wait, and the host is told who is disconnected
ON-06: invite links from the Android app use the game's real address
exclusions: Any change to prices, cards or scoring
